exposure: Mode of delivery: Cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery
Adherence to cesarean section (CS) quality indicators
outcome: Quality of care during labor and delivery
cohort: 1024 women who had a cesarean section and a stratified and weighted randomly selected group of 1036 women who had a vaginal delivery
finding: The study identified four target areas for improving obstetric care (suspected fetal distress, non-progressive labor, continuous support during labor, and previous CS) where adherence to quality indicators was low, suggesting potential for reducing CS rates.
